chunks: Have fear of the day when you go back to God. Then each will be paid back in full his reward, and no one will be wronged.

key_terms.تُوَفَّىٰ: Will be paid back in full
key_terms.يَوْمًا: A day (specifically the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What happens to every soul on the Day of Return according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute justice (Adl) of God, where the 'return' signifies the transition from the temporal world to the eternal realm of accountability. It highlights that divine recompense is precise and comprehensive, ensuring no soul is burdened beyond its capacity nor deprived of its due reward, a concept central to the Shia doctrine of divine fairness.
